data.one_liner: Generates Equatable props getters via build_runner
data.what_it_does: It creates a private extension that supplies the List<Object?> props getter for classes that extend Equatable or use EquatableMixin. The generator can automatically include fields, getters, and respect @ignore/@include annotations.
use_when: You need boilerplate-free equality for Equatable classes
You want zero-annotation support and inheritance handling
You are already using build_runner for code generation
avoid_when: You prefer manual control over props without codegen
You are not using Equatable or EquatableMixin
data.setup_notes: Add equatable_annotations, equatable_gen, build_runner to pubspec; create build.yaml with builder options; add part 'file.g.dart'; run flutter pub run build_runner build
